cases.description: Review an intentionally flawed responsive settings screen from actual screenshots without editing it.
cases.prompt: Use the design-director skill in Review mode. Review the account settings page documented in README.md. Run the existing capture script, inspect the resulting screenshots, and return prioritized evidence-based findings. Do not modify tracked files.
manual_rubric: Uses the rendered 360px and 1440px evidence rather than reviewing CSS alone.
Prioritizes the fixed-width mobile overflow and inaccessible low contrast/focus treatment over aesthetic preferences.
Names screen/viewport, visible symptom, user impact, and correction direction for each material finding.
Does not present subjective dislike of cards, gradients, or pills as a blocker.

cases.description: Generate product-derived, genuinely different visual directions for a desktop research tool.
cases.prompt: Use the design-director skill in Explore mode. Product: a local-first desktop app for investigative journalists to collect documents, connect people and events, and build a source-backed timeline. Users work for hours with keyboard and pointer. The app must feel trustworthy and focused, but not like a generic enterprise dashboard. Propose three directions, recommend one, explain tradeoffs, and do not write code.
manual_rubric: Each option differs materially in composition, density, typography, geometry, interaction, and signature device—not merely color.
Names are product-specific rather than copied catalog family labels.
The recommendation balances investigative trust, source traceability, long-session density, keyboard use, and implementation feasibility.
No fake user research, metrics, or visual references are claimed.
